environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; smooth, streamlined shell with subtle growth rings; wide, friendly eyes; the neck is visible and tucked slightly to the side; 'wet' shader effect on the shell.

visual_logic.composition: A half-submerged 'split-shot' view. Above water, the turtle's head is peeking out near a floating lily pad. Below water, its webbed feet are paddling through clear, silt-flecked water. The background shows the distinctive purple-red mudbanks of the Anacleto.
visual_logic.ground: Soft, underwater river silt and smooth river stones transitioning to thick purple clay at the water's edge.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright daylight filtering through the water surface, creating 'god rays' (caustics) that dance on the turtle's back.
